summary: Onboarding Resume Persistence and Analytics Features Testing Complete. Backend: 13/13 passed (2 skipped - customer creation returns 200 not 201). Tests verified: GET /api/onboarding/status returns analytics object with tier-level completion stats (total_steps, completed_steps, finish_later_steps, completion_percent), PUT /api/onboarding/session persists current_tier and current_step_id with last_opened_at timestamp. Frontend: Dashboard shows 'Guided Onboarding' card with 'Resume Setup' button linking to /onboarding. Onboarding hub displays all 4 analytics cards (Overall Completed: 15, Finish Later: 0, Last Activity: timestamp, Resume Step: current step name), 3 tier cards with progress percentages, checklist with step statuses, guided walkthrough panel with inline actions.

GET /api/onboarding/status analytics.description: Returns analytics object with quick_start, standard_setup, full_optimization tier stats including total_steps, completed_steps, finish_later_steps, completion_percent

GET /api/onboarding/status progress.description: Returns progress object with current_tier, current_step_id, last_opened_at from saved session

PUT /api/onboarding/session.description: Persists current_tier and current_step_id for tenant. Returns last_opened_at timestamp. Data confirmed via GET /status

Dashboard onboarding card.description: Shows 'Guided Onboarding' card with progress stats (15 completed, 0 finish later) and 'Resume Setup' button linking to /onboarding

Onboarding hub analytics cards.description: 4 analytics cards displayed: Overall Completed (15), Finish Later (0), Last Activity (timestamp), Resume Step (current step name)

Onboarding hub tier cards.description: 3 tier cards with progress: Quick Start (63%), Standard Setup (45%), Full Optimization (42%)

Onboarding hub resumes at saved step.description: Hub resumes at saved tier/step when reopened based on session data from API

Guided walkthrough panel.description: Shows step lesson, Open link button for link-type steps, Back/Next navigation, Mark Complete and Finish Later buttons

Inline quick-start actions.description: Workflow mode dropdown with Save button, Employee form with name/email/role, Pricing inputs for vinyl/banner/coroplast/rate, Portal toggle switches with Save button

Customer portal invite flow.description: Customer detail modal shows 'Customer Portal' section with portal status badge and 'Invite to Portal' button

Portal login PIN explanation.description: Portal login page shows: 'If you were invited by the shop, use the temporary PIN from the invitation email and change it after login.'

No regression - Dashboard.description: Dashboard loads with stats, widgets, time greeting, Founder badge

No regression - Tier cards.description: Quick Start, Standard Setup, Full Optimization cards with duration badges and progress
